title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 377 (Provisions of Chapter cumulative)

content.overview: The provisions of this Part with respect to unregistered companies shall be in addition to and not in derogation of any provisions in this Act with respect to the winding up of companies by the Tribunal, and the Tribunal or liquidator may exercise any powers or do any act in the case of unregistered companies which might be exercised or done by the Tribunal or liquidator in winding up companies registered under this Act.
content.glance: Part provisions on unregistered companies are cumulative; Tribunal/liquidator may exercise registered-company winding-up powers in respect of unregistered companies.
